name: APT41
description: APT41 (Double Dragon) is a Chinese state-sponsored hacker group with ties to the Ministry of State Security that conducts both espionage and financially motivated cybercrime. Named by the DOJ in September 2020, five Chinese and two Malaysian nationals were charged with compromising over 100 companies worldwide. Uniquely operates both for Chinese intelligence and for personal financial gain, attacking gaming companies for virtual currency.

sources.title: Chinese Antivirus Firm Was Part of APT41 'Supply Chain' Attack — Krebs on Security
